# HEM v0.7.0 — First stable release: lighter Home Assistant startup

This is the first **non-beta** SemVer release of Home Environment Manager
(`0.7.0`). It includes the fully validated features of the v0.6.2 beta series:
room/device profiles, monitoring and safety policies, floors, doors/windows,
environmental statistics, mold history, adaptive controllers, multilingual
descriptions and the native dashboard.

## Reduced load during Home Assistant startup

- During Home Assistant's **STARTING** state, numerous native source and registry
  events can arrive across successive event-loop turns. HEM coalesces their
  expensive full-house environmental plan rebuilds to one per 750-ms burst.
  The initial plan is still calculated immediately.
- Fault events and native device availability observations remain immediate.
  Once HA reports **RUNNING**, source-driven updates return to the next event
  loop turn. Pending startup refreshes are promoted without keeping the delay.
- When only automatic covers need a 30-second sun-clock check, HEM schedules
  the shade controller directly. It reads current weather, sun and sensor
  evidence and retains its existing movement safeguards, without rebuilding
  the entire indoor environmental report on every shade-only tick.
- Managed equipment and mixed legacy device controllers still require their
  original fast recalculations, safety checks, recovery holds, and 5-minute
  environmental verification. No sleeping/recovery safety waiting period is
  shortened. Persistence and unload cleanup remain intact.

## Verified stable publication

- New automated regression covers STARTING bursts across event-loop turns,
  immediate live updates, fail-closed equipment observations, cheap shade-only
  ticks and unchanged managed-device fast decisions.
- Stable and beta releases share an immutable, exact-commit, CI-gated publisher.
  Stable tags use `prerelease=false` and are designated the latest release;
  beta tags remain prereleases. Previous tags and ZIP files are never overwritten.
- The full Home Assistant, controller, frontend and browser regressions are
  mandatory before stable publication; the ZIP and SHA256 must match `main`.

**Upgrade guidance:** Back up your Home Assistant configuration before
updating a controller integration and check actual device behavior after an
HA restart. Publishing this repository release does not itself restart Home
Assistant, modify your local configuration or send any physical commands.
